content.rationale: The verb takes its context, names the store and the node path, resolves the id through store_resolve, attributes through store_own, reads the changed set through status, moves edits through jj_place, brackets through markers_capture, and builds its refusals through refusal; building the gate's own crate typechecks all nine calls at once, so the fan-out is gated without a second owner for the crate.
